source_chain.fact: include_reasoning defaults true; return_token_ids adds IDs, with documented streaming delta semantics.
Nonstream response emits entire output.token_ids and prompt IDs. Parser splits visible reasoning/tool fields separately. include_reasoning=false suppresses choice IDs.
Streaming emits delta IDs even for otherwise empty parser/control-token deltas; hidden reasoning suppresses metadata. Existing mini flow uses nonstreaming; do not switch it.
Exact CI LiteLLM1.108.1 forwards extra_body as OpenAI SDK option, then converts dumped response.
Unknown choice token_ids retained under provider_specific_fields; declared field participates in model_dump. No whitelist removal of token_ids.

model_kwargs passed to litellm.completion; successfully parsed actions and response.model_dump stored in message.extra. Action parsing happens before response assignment and throws FormatError: raw response lost in that case.

prefill_and_sampling: return_token_ids is response metadata, not a SamplingParams policy; existing full42823-prefix native replays already returned exactprompt/raw IDs through stock B8 route. Streaming engine support does not prove streaming mini serialization; keep existing nonstream route.
